categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P, adds `src/block_request_tracker.{h,cpp}`, and updates `src/net_processing.cpp` to track and reschedule failed block downloads across peers.
categories.rationale: Adds automated retry handling for on-demand block downloads in net_processing when peers disconnect or stall. The description notes this addresses user issue #27652 because `getblockfrompeer` lacked failure handling, and aids pruned node rescan tracking (#29183).

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Lacks the RPC label and the minor edits in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` merely expose the underlying P2P block tracker functionality.
categories.rationale: The PR belongs to P2P; the RPC category explicitly excludes the underlying behavior an RPC merely exposes.
